notes: JSON results that include saved.path are enriched with artifacts[] descriptors; cliNextActions[] only carries non-duplicate executable follow-ups.
Large or sensitive raw payloads stay in local artifacts; read bounded paths with browser-pilot artifact.

mode.description: scan | content | html | text | tabs. Default scan.

selector.description: content/html modes: CSS selector for a target readable root or exact HTML/text slice

url.description: scan/content/html/text modes: optional URL to navigate to before observation

includeLinks.description: content mode only: include Markdown links; default true

maxNodes.description: scan/text modes: maximum DOM nodes visited

includeIframes.description: scan/text modes: include same-origin iframe content

baseline.description: scan mode only: prior ABML entity list or prior scan summary/envelope used to compute envelope.diff. CLI-friendlier: use --baseline-snapshot-id or --baseline-path instead of inlining a large prior envelope.

baselineSnapshotId.description: scan mode only: snapshotId from a prior browser_observe scan; the daemon resolves it to that scan's saved entities as the baseline. CLI-friendly by-reference alternative to passing the full prior envelope inline as `baseline`.

baselinePath.description: scan mode only: filesystem path to a prior scan's saved artifact; used as the baseline. No-state by-reference alternative to inlining `baseline`.

actionRef.description: scan mode only (R3.x P1): bp-ref:// of the control you just activated; attributes the baseline network-delta to it as `triggered` relations. Falls back to the focused control when omitted.

htmlMode.description: html mode only: fragment | raw | text | inner | outer

intent.description: scan/text modes only: explicit task intent used as a relevance signal for ranking observation results

fresh.description: scan/text modes only: force a fresh full-frame observation for this call; ignores the session-delta baseline and render cache without disabling relevance or memory

tabId.description: Compatibility target: numeric tabId or stable tabHandle string. Prefer targetRef/tabHandle from browser_tabs list; omit to use the selected active tab.

targetRef.description: Stable target reference from browser_tabs list/create (tabHandle). Preferred over numeric tabId because it survives unambiguous in-place tab replacement.
